widgets.title: Methodology & limitations
widgets.text: Valid yellow-taxi trips were aggregated by month and pickup zone in the supplied exported dashboard. The snapshot includes no executable upstream SQL, raw TLC records, or live warehouse access. Rider spend includes fares, surcharges, tolls and recorded tips; cash tips are not recorded. The selected borough affects pickup-zone charts only, not citywide KPI totals.
